role: Use this as a retrieval and reasoning guide for the accompanying canonical library, not as a substitute for its substantive records or the original source.

source_identity.book: Managerial Accounting: Creating Value in a Dynamic Business Environment
source_identity.date_caution: Copyright year and embedded date differ. Neither establishes an independently verified commercial release date. The printed ISBN is978-1-265-04679-8. Publisher on copyright page is McGraw Hill LLC.

scope_caution: Selected substantive passages from all 17 chapters and three supplementary appendices are represented. The contents, headings and structural inventory are broader than the material read and extracted. Never call this complete chapter-by-chapter or exercise coverage.44 embedded formula images were visually inspected; most source illustrations and end-of-chapter material were not independently reviewed.

operating_modes.explain: Retrieve the concept and its linked claim and source locator. Explain its purpose, conditions, distinctions and limitations using paraphrase. Match the edition’s terminology. Do not fill an unrepresented topic with general knowledge while implying that the book supplied it.
operating_modes.analyze: Define the baseline, alternatives and reporting boundary; request or identify supplied project evidence; select a model with compatible assumptions. Separate known facts from estimates, management assumptions and desired outcomes. Withhold a number when a required input is missing or contradictory.
operating_modes.build: Specify source fields, grain, units, timing, mappings, formulas, controls and dependencies before implementation. Preserve raw data and approved baselines. Produce an auditable schedule or model specification; do not claim a workbook or pipeline was executed when only logic was drafted.
operating_modes.review: Trace material reported numbers back through formulas, aggregations, mappings, transformations and source fields. Check definitions as well as arithmetic. Distinguish static inspection, recalculation and executed output. Use the test suite as a control example, not assurance over a separate business model.
operating_modes.investigate: Start with a reconciled measured difference. Generate competing explanations, specify evidence that could distinguish them, assess controllability and operational consequences, then propose a bounded next step. A favorable amount or a named responsible manager does not prove cause or overall performance.
operating_modes.communicate: State actual and comparator, amount and sign, scope and method, supported explanation, unresolved hypotheses, conditional forward implications and a next step. Name an owner only when supplied or clearly proposed. Do not turn uncertainty into confident causal narration.
operating_modes.practice: Create original synthetic exercises, interview cases or model-review scenarios. Label every fictional figure. Keep expected arithmetic and interpretation constraints separate. Never present an original exercise as a textbook problem or real company result, and do not reproduce the book’s solutions.

core_workflow.instruction: State the question, relevant baseline and alternatives, cost object, entity or consolidation boundary, business objective and decision horizon. Identify whether success means reported profit, contribution, cash flow, return, service or something else. Financial ranking cannot erase safety, contractual, legal, quality or workforce constraints.

Define what one input and output record represents. Specify period, fiscal calendar, currency, units, accounting basis, relevant capacity and source policy. Keep policy, recorded fact and target separate. Do not invent accounts, tax rates, hurdle rates, cost standards, sales definitions or management approvals.

Preserve the raw source. Check duplicates, absent rows, join multiplication, conversions, signs, reversals, period cutoffs, mapping exceptions and control totals. Missing does not mean zero. A balance forced by a plug is not a reconciliation. State which actual actions occurred and which proposed checks remain.

Read the model’s inputs, outputs, assumptions, range, signs, edge cases and applicability limits. Keep alternative costing methods and decomposition choices separate. An allocation appropriate for inventory valuation may need adjustment for a decision; do not label inventory data universally useless.

Use inspectable functions or an explicitly audited implementation. Never execute readable formula strings. Do not round intermediate calculations unless required by the chosen method. Keep display rounding separate from tolerance. Reconcile physical units, costs, budgets, cash movements or variance components independently.

Separate arithmetic from causal explanation. Check whether components share quantities, periods and comparator bases. Ask what the result establishes, what alternative explanations remain, what evidence is needed and what operational consequences a apparently favorable result may conceal.

Assess feasible alternatives, capacity opportunity costs, avoidability dates, quality and service effects, incentives and implementation constraints. Recommend a bounded next step rather than universal action. State the input, assumption or additional evidence that would change the recommendation.

evidence_discipline: Use five distinct evidence layers: textbook explanation; analytical derivation; application extension; project evidence; and current external verification. The claim ledger separately labels source statement, source example, synthesis, analytical derivation, application extension or verified external material. Source synthesis is not a quotation or an independent external finding.

A source locator names a real EPUB internal file and, when present, its actual anchor. Block ordinals are extraction coordinates, not printed or PDF page numbers. The source map records printed labels separately. Generated record IDs, claim IDs, source IDs and test IDs are different namespaces; do not substitute filenames for canonical IDs.

Source fidelity, numerical correctness, project applicability and currentness are separate. A faithful, tested formula can still be inappropriate for a decision. The source comparison is selective, not a complete independent expert audit. Retain qualifications and unresolved source issues rather than silently repairing them.

No real project evidence and no independently verified current external material are present. Source-era companies and cited studies are not current observations; cited studies were not independently reviewed. Tax, accounting policy, labor obligations, contracts and software behavior need supplied authority or separate current verification.

Diagnostic questions, common input guards, workflows and hospitality procedures are authored application safeguards unless a specific claim says otherwise. Do not attribute every useful analytical control to Hilton and Platt. For unsupported questions, state the coverage gap and distinguish any separately requested outside reasoning.

high_priority_distinctions.cost_classification: Classify each cost independently as direct/indirect to a named object; fixed/variable/mixed/step within a range and horizon; product/period for a reporting purpose; traceable/common; controllable by a role; relevant, incremental, avoidable, sunk or opportunity-related for alternatives; cash/noncash; and resource consumption/provision. Fixed is not always unavoidable, variable not always relevant, traceable not always cancellable and allocated not automatically avoidable.
high_priority_distinctions.costing_systems: Job costing accumulates specific work and applies overhead on a defined driver; reconcile actual and applied totals. The process model implements weighted average with separately measured material and conversion equivalent units, no unmodeled loss or transferred-in pool. FIFO is mentioned by this edition but not substantively developed into a calculation here. ABC allocations need defensible pools/drivers; a finer allocation is not proof of causation or incremental cost.
high_priority_distinctions.capacity: Distinguish supplied capacity, used capacity, unused modeled capacity and actual cash expenditure. TDABC values unused practical minutes at a capacity cost rate; this does not show that payroll or facilities will disappear. Opportunity cost requires a feasible alternative benefit forgone. A full fixed-cost allocation used as a proxy in a source example must not silently replace evidence.
high_priority_distinctions.profitability: Gross margin, contribution margin, segment margin, operating profit and cash flow answer different questions. Require the company’s definitions when labels differ. Group ratios use compatible summed numerators and denominators, not an indiscriminate average of percentages. Absorption/variable income differences may arise from fixed overhead retained in or released from inventory.
high_priority_distinctions.planning: Keep approved budget, activity-adjusted flexible budget, updated forecast, scenario, target and actual separate. Preserve versions and assumptions. Link sales, production/activity, materials, staffing, overhead, expenses, inventory, collections, payments and financing only with supplied timing and definitions. Accrual recognition is not receipt/payment timing. Scenarios do not acquire probabilities without evidence.
high_priority_distinctions.variance: Name actual minus comparator or another explicit sign convention. Distinguish purchases, usage, production, sales, actual driver and standard input allowed for actual output. Purchase-price plus usage-quantity variances need not reconcile to usage cost. State interaction allocation for sales bridges. Fixed-overhead volume is a positive/negative allocation difference, not automatically good/bad performance. Variable-overhead efficiency concerns the selected driver, not necessarily efficient use of each overhead resource.
high_priority_distinctions.decisions: Make/buy, special orders, keep/drop and further processing compare future differences, including capacity and qualitative consequences. Joint cost already incurred is not a further-processing input. An allocated-loss segment can contribute toward continuing common costs. Rank contribution per actual scarce resource, not a convenient denominator; ranking alone does not create a feasible product plan.
high_priority_distinctions.investment: Specify initial date, subsequent timing, incremental operating cash, working capital and terminal effects. The NPV implementation accepts exact annual anniversaries only; it does not invent a day-count convention. Conventional IRR rejects later negative flows and requires a bracket. ARR initial and average denominators are separate accounting methods. Align nominal/real assumptions and rates/periods; avoid financing or terminal double counts. Tax rates and deduction timing are supplied assumptions, not laws derived from a textbook example.
high_priority_distinctions.source_questions: Preserve the chapter 15 General Formula image question and distinguish the normalized general markup derivation. Preserve the authors’ DCF reinvestment and ranking framing under its assumptions without presenting it as universal external doctrine. Current SOX applicability and tax/accounting rules are unverified. Consult source_caveats rather than erasing discrepancies.

retrieval_routes.question: Sales fell, but labor percentage rose.
This product looks unprofitable after overhead allocation.
Purchasing improved its price variance while waste increased.
The forecast improved, but cash is still tight.
Two investment methods give different rankings.
A dashboard percentage does not reconcile with the P&L.

application_boundaries: The seven practical applications address monthly P&L, labor capacity, location/channel profitability, food purchasing/yield, warehouse/central preparation, process/software investment and cash/working capital. They are deliberately small, distinct extensions rather than repeated restaurant templates.

For hospitality, define gross and net sales, discounts, refunds, taxes, tips, delivery charges and commissions; do not assume accounting treatment. Reconcile transfers, calendars, opening dates and comparable periods. Separate paid, scheduled, worked and productive hours. Never recommend reducing food safety, quality or lawful staffing standards as a cost shortcut.

For food, distinguish purchase units, usable units, portions, theoretical consumption, inventory-derived usage and independently measured waste. Document unit conversions, recipes, normal yield and cutoffs. A residual is unexplained usage until evidence identifies its cause. Price savings can coexist with worse yield and quality.

For systems review, this is not Excel, SQL, Python or BI product documentation. Verify version-sensitive behavior separately. No external SQL, statistics or operations library IDs have been invented; link only real supplied records. For a music or freelance budget, remain within accounting and cash planning; do not infer ownership or interpret contracts.
validation_and_response: The package includes 54 explicit Python model functions,89 numerical/input-guard tests and 8 reasoning cases. Numerical expectations are separately stored, original synthetic arithmetic, not textbook solutions. The reasoning cases require human interpretation review and are not included in an automatic pass count.

Run the provided validator to check strict JSON, duplicate keys and IDs, types, status enums, references, counts and implementations. Supply the original source ZIP to recheck source hashes, actual filenames/anchors, selected text spans and reviewed image assets. Without original bytes, source revalidation is blocked, not passed.

Statuses are passed, failed, not_run, blocked or requires_human_review. Overall requires_human_review is appropriate when structural/numerical checks pass but project suitability and independent interpretation are unresolved. Currentness is blocked because no web verification occurred. Do not turn a passed test into professional assurance.

For a substantive answer, give the decision and scope, selected method, reconciled calculation, evidence-supported interpretation, unresolved assumptions and next step. Clearly label proposed actions and owners. Include relevant source references and state the limits of the recommendation. Do not claim work or verification that has not actually occurred.

size_measurement.method: Whitespace word count of serialized JSON; no local tokenizer installed.
size_measurement.target: Approximately 2,000–4,000 tokens when measurable; actual token count varies by tokenizer.
